# openinfra_batch_transform (Resource)

A run-once, offline batch-inference job (SageMaker Batch Transform) — loads a model, scores an input dataset, and writes predictions to the object store, then exits. The offline counterpart to openinfra_model (a live endpoint).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Inference container image. Reads the input records, optionally loads a model artifact, and writes predictions.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Optional container args.
- `artifact` (Attributes) The model to score with (injected as ARTIFACT_BUCKET/ARTIFACT_KEY). Optional if baked into the image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifact))
- `backoff_limit` (Number) Pod retries before the job is marked Failed.
- `command` (List of String) Optional entrypoint override.
- `cpu` (String) CPU request/limit.
- `env` (Attributes List) Environment variables for the inference container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `gpu` (Number) GPUs to request. `0` (default) runs CPU-only.
- `gpu_tier` (String) GPU class when gpu>0. One of: `smallgpu`, `largegpu`.
- `input` (Attributes) The dataset to score (injected as INPUT_BUCKET/INPUT_PREFIX). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input))
- `max_runtime_seconds` (Number) Hard wall-clock cap (Job activeDeadlineSeconds). Unset means no cap.
- `memory` (String) Memory request/limit.
- `model_package` (String) Provenance: the ModelPackage this job scores with.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `output` (Attributes) Where predictions are written (injected as OUTPUT_BUCKET/OUTPUT_PREFIX; bucket created on demand). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--output))
- `secrets` (List of String) Extra secrets to inject with envFrom.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `job_name` (String) The batch Job the run executes as.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
